## Education

::: cv-entry
**PhD in soil ecology** [2023 – 2026]{.cv-date}\
*Doctoral School GAIA · Institut Agro Montpellier · UMR Eco&Sols, Montpellier, France*\
Thesis: "Soil ecology in the digital age: challenges and contributions of automated edaphic biodiversity monitoring" defended in August 2026.\
Jointly funded by CIRAD and the INRAE BIOSEFAIR Metaprogramme.
:::

::: cv-entry
**Agricultural Engineering Degree (Ingénieure Agronome)** [2017 – 2022]{.cv-date}\
*École Supérieure d'Agricultures, Angers, France*\
Major: Plant Production & Agroecology · Honours: Excellent.
:::

## Research experience

::: cv-entry
**Research Engineer** [2023 · 5 months]{.cv-date}\
*INRAE, UMR Eco&Sols, Montpellier, France*\
Evaluated the efficacy of in-situ optical scanners for high-temporal-resolution monitoring of soil biological activity.
:::

::: cv-entry
**Research Engineer** [2022 · 1 month]{.cv-date}\
*INRAE, UMR Eco&Sols, Montpellier, France*\
Assessed the potential of in situ optical imaging to track edaphic activity. Writing of a scientific publication on image-based soil biological monitoring.
:::

::: cv-entry
**Graduate Research Intern** [2022 · 6 months]{.cv-date}\
*CIRAD, UMR Eco&Sols, Montpellier, France*\
"Potential of in situ imaging for monitoring biological activity in soils" \
Quantified the spatial and temporal dynamics of soil biological communities (fauna, roots, fungal hyphae) in truffle orchard soils via image analysis.
:::
